szenen.vo: [intense] Listen, bro, you've got two options right now, you can stay exactly where you are, or you can go up.
[intense] Staying is easy, same room, same excuses, same life, every single year, until it's too late.
[intense] And don't tell me tomorrow, don't tell me next week, because next week turns into next year.
[intense] There will always be problems and something in your way, so you might as well start now.
[shouting] So stop waiting for the perfect moment and go up, one step at a time!
[shouting] We're not staying here, bro. We're going up!
